label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 088 ]

blocks.text: An increasing emphasis on the value of time is changing consumers’ behavior. A recent survey has found that shoppers want more time for themselves, and one way to get it is to spend less time shopping. Because of this change, shop owners are changing store designs to make shopping and consumer service easier. For example, to help busy shoppers race through the store, companies now display floor plans in many different places throughout the store. Also, they have made their stores bigger to minimize time spent shopping.

readingSentences.english: An increasing emphasis on the value of time is changing consumers’ behavior.
readingSentences.korean: 시간의 가치가 더 중요하게 여겨짐에 따라서 소비자들의 행동에도 변화가 생기고 있다.

readingSentences.english: A recent survey has found that shoppers want more time for themselves, and one way to get it is to spend less time shopping.
readingSentences.korean: 최근의 조사에 의하면, 구매자들은 자신만의 시간을 더 갖고 싶어 하고, 그것을 위한 한 가지 방법은 쇼핑 시간을 줄이는 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Because of this change, shop owners are changing store designs to make shopping and consumer service easier.
readingSentences.korean: 이러한 변화로 인해, 가게 소유자들은 고객이 쇼핑을 더 수월하게 하도록 하고 고객 서비스를 더 쉽게 하기 위해 가게의 디자인을 바꾸고 있다.

readingSentences.english: For example, to help busy shoppers race through the store, companies now display floor plans in many different places throughout the store.
readingSentences.korean: 예를 들어, 바쁜 구매자들이 매장에서 빠르게 이동할 수 있도록 회사들은 가게 전체의 여러 곳에 층별 지도를 붙여 둔다.

readingSentences.english: Also, they have made their stores bigger to minimize time spent shopping.
readingSentences.korean: 또 쇼핑하는 데 걸리는 시간을 최소화하기 위해 매장들의 규모를 확대해 왔다.
